summary: David Shier, 81, with medical issues/possible dementia, last seen ~11 a.m. Friday near County Road 20.2 by the Walmart in Trinidad; reported missing that afternoon when he failed to return home. On Saturday, Feb 12, an extensive multi-agency search -- vehicle, ATV, foot and K9 teams plus aerial -- by the Las Animas County Sheriff's Office with Trinidad Ambulance District, Colorado Parks & Wildlife, Huerfano County Sheriff's Office, Flight for Life, Stonewall/Fishers Peak/Hoehne fire departments, Colorado Search and Rescue, Las Animas County SAR, and Pinon Canyon personnel was unable to locate him. As of Feb 18 he was still missing; he was never found.
responding_agency: Las Animas County Sheriff's Office; Las Animas County SAR
notes: Date = missing date 2022-02-11 (Friday; major search Saturday 2022-02-12). Never located; case cold (The Vanished podcast, 2025). Outcome = fatality (presumed; never located) per index convention for never-located missing subjects (cf. id 1160). First indexed Las Animas County row.
